priorPin: Pacta's Aave V3 Base governance surfaces were pinned at Base block 57886975. Independent reads of the reserve strategy at that block and at 59261022 show USDC (9000, 0, 475, 1000) and EURC (9000, 0, 750, 4000), in basis points (optimal utilization, base variable borrow rate, slope 1, slope 2). At 59261023, RateDataUpdate logs 9 and 12 in transaction 0xab127ca8d77b79ca15e10e9a4ffe286b694547e80ff4a8addea58bfdf4331d56 record USDC (9200, 0, 485, 1000) and EURC (9000, 0, 700, 4000).
